candidate: GDS (Wanguo Data) Zhongwei Integrated Green Advanced Demonstration Data Center Industrial Park, A-zone (Phases 1 and 2), Xuanhe
selected_point_role: area centroid of the one industrial parcel on the official Xuanhe detailed-plan land-use map that is bounded by Jingsan Road (west), Wanyun Road (north), the Sandang Highway corridor (east) and Weiliu Road (south), i.e. the land described by the A-zone Phase 1 and Phase 2 planning permits together; locates the two-phase A-zone campus, not a building, the Phase 1 half or a surveyed boundary

permit_boundaries.phase_1: construction-project planning permit 6405022026GG0074699: east Sandang Highway, south Weiliu Road (纬六路), north the A-zone Phase 2 land; real-estate unit 640502105212GB00038W00000000
permit_boundaries.phase_2: construction-project planning permit 6405022026GG0075620: east Sandang Highway, north Wanyun Road (万云路), south the adjoining A-zone land (printed as the Phase 2 land; the Phase 1 permit shows it is Phase 1); real-estate unit 640502105212GB00039W00000000

parcel_identification.detailed_plan_roads: Detailed-plan text: Wanyun Road is a secondary road with an 8 m red line; Weiliu Road is a trunk road; Sandang Highway is the county road with a 26 m red line. On the land-use map (page 4, 11 土地使用规划图) Wanyun Road runs between Jingsan Road and Sandang Highway, and the only parcel south of Wanyun Road, north of Weiliu Road and west of Sandang Highway is the parcel traced here.
parcel_identification.phase_1_board: Phase 1 scheme board (18 September 2026, 1:1000, north-up) shows 纬六路 along the south red line and a planned 8 m urban branch road (城市规划支路) along the north red line, with Sandang Highway entrances on the east; site area 15.3235 ha (229.85 mu) for Phase 1.
parcel_identification.phase_2_board: Phase 2 scheme board (18 September 2026): site area 220.23 mu (14.68 ha).
parcel_identification.area_check: Traced parcel 29.91 ha in the registered geometry versus 30.00 ha for Phase 1 plus Phase 2 (229.85 + 220.23 mu); splitting the traced parcel at its mid-line gives 15.38 ha (south) and 14.53 ha (north) against 15.32 ha (Phase 1, south) and 14.68 ha (Phase 2, north).

imagery.layer: Esri World Imagery MapServer export, EPSG:4326, 2400x2150 px

extent_as_returned_by_server.note: The server widened the requested latitude range (37.342-37.392) to keep square degree pixels; the returned extent is used.

registration.method: Normalised cross-correlation of 64x64 px plan patches (24 px grid) against the imagery resampled to plan geometry around a coarse prior from six large-template matches; peaks below 0.45 or on the search-window edge discarded; RANSAC affine fit (6 px threshold).
registration.transform_note: Near-similarity: rotation about 0.3 deg, x and y scales 6.453 and 6.464 m per plan px.

independent_checks.eia_points_on_registered_plan: Official EIA station-centre coordinates read as WGS84 land on or beside data-centre parcels of the registered plan: Zhonglian Xuanhe 330 kV substation (105.490514, 37.368346) at plan px (538.6, 523.8), the north-west corner of the parcel east of the Sandang Highway auxiliary road; CIDC Xuanhe 330 kV substation (105.498315, 37.378340) at (644.7, 351.8), in the green strip on the south edge of the north-east block; China Mobile D-zone 110 kV substation (105.504329, 37.370328) at (727.8, 488.9), on the east edge of the eastern block. None falls in open land outside the planned area.
independent_checks.imagery: The traced parcel falls on undeveloped land immediately west of the Sandang Highway corridor in the imagery, with its south side parallel to an existing WNW-ESE track; the imagery date is not stated and predates any A-zone works.
independent_checks.phase_boards: Both phase boards are north-up and show the same quadrilateral split into a southern and a northern half.

uncertainty: Not established. Image-to-image registration residuals are about 5 m RMS (15.5 m max), but the plan is a 6.5 m per px planning raster without geodetic control, Esri World Imagery has no stated absolute accuracy or acquisition date here, and the parcel corners were traced manually (about 1 px). The point is an interior anchor in a 30 ha parcel; estimated within roughly 50 m of the true parcel centroid.
